en.description:
A pin sweeps around the dial. Tap the moment it lines up with the target
and the lock pops open. Miss by a fraction and the run is over.

That is the whole game. It gets harder because the pin speeds up, the
target shrinks, and the direction flips every time you hit it.

LEVELS
Every level changes something. Faster sweeps, tighter windows, targets in
places you were not looking. Find out how far you get before your timing
breaks.

INFINITE
No levels and no ceiling. One run until you miss. This is where the
leaderboard scores come from.

GLOBAL LEADERBOARD
Pick a name, pick your country, and see exactly where you land against
players worldwide. Filter to your own region when the global board feels
out of reach.

PLAYS ON BOTH
The full game runs on iPhone and Apple Watch. One purchase covers both,
and every score lands on the same leaderboard whichever one you played
on. Works offline and syncs the next time you reconnect. A round takes
ten seconds, so it fits in a lift ride or a queue.

WHAT IS NOT IN IT
No ads. No energy timers. No waiting to play again. No in-app purchases.
You buy it once and that is the whole thing.

Requires iOS 18 or later. Apple Watch Series 4 and later, SE, and Ultra.
